data: What is the approximate value of the green line at the x-axis value of 100 in the rightmost plot?

The green line represents K=32 sigmoid/softmax scoring. The x-axis value of 100 corresponds to the rightmost plot. At this point, the green line appears to be approximately at the value of 4 on the y-axis. Therefore, the approximate value of the green line at the x-axis value of 100 in the rightmost plot is 4.
